verdict.rationale: The pricing page says the open-source library adds search "at no cost" (orama-docs-12), and self-hosting avoids per-request billing. Orama Cloud's context server can also run on your own infrastructure (orama-docs-8). However, the evidence shows no Cloud plan tiers, record or query limits, or overage terms, so predictability for the managed offering is unverified. The pricing page instead describes an assessment-led enterprise engagement (orama-docs-52). Missing for 10: published Cloud pricing tiers, documented record and query-volume limits, overage/per-request policy, independent corroboration of cost predictability at scale.
